name: Customer order is saved and a GCash reference can be submitted
description: Verifies the five current cocktail names are accepted, the exact total is shown with the Paws & Brew QR, and submitting a reference does not mark payment as verified.
steps: Add Paw Sunrise, Paw Splash, Blueberry Mojito, Strawberry Mojito, and Watermelon Mojito to the cart
Open checkout, enter a valid customer name and Philippine mobile number, and choose Pickup
Submit the order and review the GCash payment instructions
Confirm the exact amount due is ₱435 and the Paws & Brew QR code is visible
Enter a valid GCash payment reference number and submit it
Review the order-received confirmation
expected: The order is saved with all five cocktail items and a total of ₱435. The customer sees the Paws & Brew GCash QR and can submit one reference number; the confirmation and staff record show payment pending verification, not paid.

name: Invalid GCash reference is rejected without changing payment status
description: Verifies a too-short or malformed reference number is rejected and the order remains awaiting a valid customer reference.
steps: Create a valid pickup order and open its GCash payment instructions
Enter a three-character reference number
Submit the reference form
expected: A validation message is shown, the customer remains on the payment screen, and the order is not marked as having a submitted or verified payment.

name: Staff dashboard shows daily, weekly and monthly order and sales totals
covers: today order count and sales value
current week order count and sales value
current month order count and sales value
cancelled orders excluded from sales value
description: Verifies the staff dashboard displays three reporting periods with order counts and sales values, using Philippine local dates and currency.
steps: Sign in to the staff dashboard using an authorized staff account
Review the Orders & sales report section above the order list
Confirm Today, This week, and This month each display an order count and a peso sales value
Compare the displayed periods with the dates and totals of the orders shown in the dashboard
expected: The report displays daily, Monday-to-current-day weekly, and month-to-current-day order counts and sales values in Philippine pesos. Cancelled orders remain in the order count but do not contribute to sales value.

name: Online table reservation appears for staff and creates a copyable SMS
description: Verifies a customer booking is saved with all requested details, appears in the staff reservation section, and produces a personalized message when staff changes its status.
steps: Submit a table reservation with a name, mobile number, date, time, guest count, pets selection, and notes
Sign in to the staff dashboard using an authorized account
Refresh the dashboard and review the new reservation notice and reservation card
Confirm the card displays the customer name, phone, date, time, guest count, pets, and notes
Change the reservation status to Confirmed
Review and copy the generated reservation SMS
expected: The booking appears in Online table reservations with all submitted details. A new-reservation notice or pending count is visible, and changing its status produces a personalized copyable SMS without sending an automatic or paid SMS.

name: Staff verifies payment before confirming an order and gets a status SMS
description: Verifies staff can manually verify a submitted GCash reference, then advance the order and copy the matching customer SMS.
steps: Sign in to the staff dashboard using an authorized account
Open an order whose customer has submitted a GCash reference
Review the reference number and choose Mark GCash payment verified
Change the order status to Confirmed
Review the generated customer SMS and use Copy SMS
expected: Payment changes to verified only after the staff action. The order can then be confirmed, and a personalized copyable SMS appears; no SMS is automatically sent.

name: Both authorized staff accounts share orders and reservation updates
covers: status updates visible to both staff accounts after refresh
description: Verifies both the existing owner account and Nikka's authorized email can access the same private staff data and see persisted status changes after refresh.
steps: Open #staff while signed out and confirm private order and reservation data is not shown
Sign in as the existing owner staff account and note an existing order and reservation
Sign in as nikka.lizardo@gmail.com in a separate browser session
Confirm both accounts can see the same order and reservation records
Change an order or reservation status in Actor A's session
Refresh Actor B's dashboard and confirm the updated status is visible
Confirm the dashboard's Refresh control and automatic live updates show the shared server state
expected: Only signed-in authorized accounts can access staff data. The existing owner account and nikka.lizardo@gmail.com can both view the same server-backed orders and reservations; status changes made by either account persist and appear in the other account through live updates.
